context: Tests whether the agent subscribes to AEM Forms custom events through the field model (fieldModel.subscribe(cb, 'eventName') inside the register callback, without the custom: prefix) instead of DOM event listeners, and combines that with listenChanges value handling.

checklist.name: Files, viewType and registration
checklist.description: Files exist under `blocks/form/components/verified-email/` (`verified-email.js`, `verified-email.css`, `_verified-email.json`), the JSON sets `"fd:viewType": "verified-email"` with `"fieldType": "email"`, and `'verified-email'` is in `customComponents` in `mappings.js`

checklist.name: Model custom-event subscription
checklist.description: The component handles the events via `fieldModel.subscribe(callback, 'emailVerified')` and `fieldModel.subscribe(callback, 'emailRejected')` (event names WITHOUT the `custom:` prefix) registered inside the `'register'` branch of the `subscribe()` callback

checklist.name: No DOM listener for custom events
checklist.description: The solution does NOT use `addEventListener` on the field wrapper/element/document to receive `emailVerified`, `emailRejected` or `custom:*` events

checklist.name: listenChanges value reset
checklist.description: `subscribe` is imported from `'../../rules/index.js'` and called with `{ listenChanges: true }`; on a `'change'` payload whose `propertyName` is `value` the badge is cleared

checklist.name: Authorable badge text
checklist.description: `_verified-email.json` adds text properties for the verified (and optionally rejected) messages with unique names, and the JS reads them from the field JSON `properties` with sensible defaults

checklist.name: README documents events
checklist.description: `README.md` for the component documents the custom events it listens to (`emailVerified`, `emailRejected`) and how they are dispatched (`custom:` prefix from a custom function)

checklist.name: Accessible status
checklist.description: The badge/message is exposed accessibly (e.g. `role="status"`, `aria-live`, or associated via `aria-describedby`)

checklist.name: Default export decorate
checklist.description: `verified-email.js` exports a default `decorate` function and only uses relative imports that include the `.js` extension
